title: A few dozen UAP reports are real, some known from inside government

plain: Out of the many thousands of reports of UAP, the newer official term for UFOs (unidentified anomalous phenomena), a few dozen are real, says Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA. He tells Michels that he has "guilty knowledge" of some of those cases from his years inside the government. He makes the case alongside a colleague he names, Chris Gilbert, and in a book called The New Science of UFOs. Coming from an insider, the claim would mean some of these cases are known to be genuine within government.
